questions.question: In the following question, select the odd number pair from the given alternatives.
questions.solution:
The logic is:

1) 5 – 20 → 5 × 4 = 20

2) 9 – 54 → 9 × 6 = 54

3) 7 – 28 → 7 × 4 = 28

4) 11 – 44 → 11 × 4 = 44

In all the options except ‘9 – 54’, the second term is obtained by multiplying the first term by 4.

Hence, ‘9 - 54’ is the odd one out.

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements is followed by some conclusions. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. No pencil is table.

II. Some table are red.

**Conclusions:**

I. All red are table.

II. Some pencils are red.
questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2fa3faeebc7fd9ea1cf5ffb9a21ab222c97ed737de2c9337cb19d3be7f64b37.png] 

I. All red are table. → False (It can be possible but it is not definite)

II. Some pencils are red. → False (It can be possible but it is not definite)

Hence, neither conclusion (I) nor conclusion (II) follows.

questions.question: If the compound interest on a certain sum for 2 years at the rate of 8% per annum is Rs. 832, then what will be the simple interest (in Rs) at the same rate of interest for 2 years?
If trader sells an article at Rs. 528, then his loss is 12%. What is the cost price (in Rs.) of the article?
questions.solution:
**Given **

Selling price = 528

Loss percentage = 12%

**Calculation**

Let cost price be 100x.

Hence, loss = 12x

Now, selling price = 100x - 12x = 88x

According to question

88x = 528

⇒ x = 6

∴ Cost price = 100x = 100 × 6 = Rs. 600.

questions.question:
In the following question, select the missing number from the given series.

9, 19, 40, 83, 170 ?
questions.solution:
The logic is:

9 + 10 = 19

19 + [(10 × 2) + 1] = 40

40 + [(21 × 2) + 1] = 83

83 + [(43 × 2) + 1] = 170

170 + [(87 × 2) + 1] = 345

Alternative method:

Difference of difference is double of the previous one.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a738f0cbd441f225ecd015307f06af0f68f4eb1f7ed2d54e7794a51c541db317.png] 

Hence, ‘345’ is the correct answer.
